# Everyday Calculation

> A comprehensive online platform offering financial calculators, health tools, and lifestyle utilities for everyday personal and professional needs.

Everyday Calculation provides a suite of free online calculators covering financial planning (loans, investments, deposits), health metrics (BMI, calories, pregnancy), and lifestyle conversions. The platform serves users across India and globally through web and mobile applications, with tools tailored for common financial instruments like EMI, SIP, FD, and RD calculations.

## Key Topics

- Financial Calculators
- Investment Tools
- Loan & EMI Calculators
- Compound Interest
- Health Calculators
- BMI & Calorie Tracking
- Unit Converters
- Annuity & Savings Planning
- Fixed Deposits (FD)
- Recurring Deposits (RD)
- Systematic Investment Plan (SIP)
- Financial Planning
- Interest Calculators
- Lifestyle Tools
- Android & iOS Apps

## Financial Calculators

- [Online Financial Calculators](https://everydaycalculation.com/financial-calculators.php): Financial calculators directory: interest, loan, NPV, IRR, MIRR tools
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/simple-interest.php): Simple interest calculator for principal, rate, and duration calculations
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/compound-interest.php): Compound interest calculator with daily, weekly, monthly, annual compounding
- [Fixed Deposit (FD) Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/fixed-deposit.php): Fixed deposit calculator for cumulative FD and monthly income schemes
- [Recurring Deposit (RD) Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/recurring-deposit.php): Recurring deposit calculator for Indian bank RD schemes and maturity values
- [Annualized Return Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/annualized-return.php): Annualized return calculator for investment ROI over specified time periods

## Loan & Investment Planning

- [Loan EMI Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/emi.php): EMI calculator for personal, home, and car loan repayment schedules
- [Advanced Loan Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/mortgage.php): Advanced loan calculator with amortization schedule for various repayment periods
- [SIP Return Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/sip.php): SIP return calculator for systematic investments and periodic savings planning
- [Annuity Payment Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/annuity-payment.php): Annuity payment calculator for monthly, quarterly, and annual payouts
- [Future Value of Annuity Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/future-value-annuity.php): Future value of annuity calculator for simple and complex annuities

## Health & Wellness Calculators

- [Online Health Calculators](https://everydaycalculation.com/health-calculators.php): Health calculators directory: BMI, BMR, body fat, calorie burned tools
- [BMI Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/bmi.php): BMI calculator for body mass index and ideal weight classification
- [Daily Calorie Intake Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/daily-calorie-need.php): Daily calorie intake calculator based on BMR and activity level
- [Age Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/age.php): Age calculator from date of birth in years, months, weeks, days

## Pregnancy & Fertility Tools

- [Baby Due Date Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/pregnancy-date.php): Pregnancy due date calculator using Naegele's Rule and menstrual period
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://everydaycalculation.com/ovulation-calendar.php): Ovulation calculator for fertile window and pregnancy conception timing

## Lifestyle & Utilities

- [Home & Lifestyle Calculators](https://everydaycalculation.com/lifestyle-calculators.php): Lifestyle calculators directory: energy, fuel, pet age, zodiac tools
